title: fix(2d): Pass starts at (Auto/Inside/Outside) for 2D Offset
body:
## What changed

A 2D Offset with an Outside containment cut each level core-first. On the band between the stock reach and the part, the core is the middle of the band. So the first ring was a full slot in the stock (#3316).

This PR adds the shared parameter `PassStart { Auto, Inside, Outside }` and gives it to 2D Offset only.

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs`: the type and its ring law (`PassStart::rank`).
  - Auto: the core first. This is the old `Reverse(k)` stable sort, byte for byte.
  - Outside: the outer boundary family (counter-clockwise loops) from the boundary in, then the hole family from the core back to its wall. On an Outside band the tool starts outside the stock and ends on the part wall.
  - Inside: the mirror.
- `waterscan.rs`: `waterline_passes` reads the rank. New entry points `pocket_started` and `pocket_avoid_started`. The old entry points and `plan_passes` call them with Auto, so the 3-D pocket, the HSM fallback and rest machining do not change. `plan_passes` moves to `pocket_plan.rs` (400-line law).
- `OpParams::Offset2D.pass_start`: seed Auto. `EditOperationParams` carries it with undo. The digest writes it only off Auto.
- Project key `pass_start` (`PassStartDto`). `auto` is never written. No version step.
- MCP: the generic `edit_operation` patch. The patch guard keeps an explicit `"auto"`. An unknown word is refused. Skill row in `camcraft-mcp`.
- UI: one Passes-tab row `Pass starts at` (`pass_start_row.rs`), shown for 2D Offset.
- User guide row and the decision file `docs/decisions/3316-pass-start-shared.md` (it leaves room for the #1448 start point).

## Readings

fig8.step, EM-0800-4FL, Outside containment, Clearance top of stock +10, Top +0, Bottom selection +1.5, Stepdown 10, hop off, stock box 5 mm past the part:
- Before (Auto): the first ring of each level starts 0.000 mm outside the stock box (in the stock).
- After (Outside): the first ring starts 4.000 mm outside the stock (the ring at the stock edge plus the tool radius). Each level ends 4.000 mm from the part outline, on the wall.
- Auto and Outside: zero lateral rapids below Z 32, and no `RapidInStock` warning.

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-app` `offset_pass_start`:
  - `fig8_outside_offset_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge` (red on the old order: the first ring was 0.000 mm outside the stock).
  - `fig8_auto_offset_keeps_every_lateral_rapid_at_the_clearance_plane` (Auto keeps the old order; #3319 guard).
  - `mcp_sets_pass_start_refuses_an_unknown_word_and_undo_restores_it` (MCP, undo, project round-trip).
- `camcraft-motion` lib `pass_start::tests::auto_is_core_first_and_the_two_sides_mirror`.
- `camcraft-ui` lib `egui_app::tests::pass_start::*` (2 tests) and the 2D Offset row in `every_field_lives_on_exactly_one_section`.

## Quick gate (debug, final head except the clippy allow line and a hint text, which were checked by clippy and the UI lib run)

- motion: lib 533 ok; `machining2d` 68 ok; `corner_arc_radius` 8 ok; `rest2d` 13 ok; `equal_steps` 13 ok.
- app: lib 297 ok; `offset_pass_start` 3 ok; `roughing2d` 7 ok (`offset_kind_is_the_pockets_ring_tiling`); `golden_cl` 33 ok; `conformance` 7 ok; `corner_relief` 4 ok; `corner_relief_safety` 3 ok; `shoulder_adaptive` 7 ok; `do_not_touch` 3 ok; `open_band` 7 ok; `keep_law` 31 ok; `blind_slot` 4 ok; `adaptive_pinch` 1 ok; `tilted_gouge_kinds` 10 ok; `setup_align_2d_kinds` 8 ok; `adaptive_trochoid` 12 ok; `project_roundtrip` 76 ok; `mcp` 23 ok; `mcp_compact` 7 ok; `mcp_enum_patch` 3 ok; `mcp_doc_drift` 6 ok.
- ui: lib 1425 ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The goldens are byte-identical: `golden_cl` and `conformance` pass with no golden change.

## Not exercised

- #3319 is not reproduced. The pin with the reported heights shows no lateral rapid below Z 32 for stock margins 0 to 20 mm. The cause of #3319 is not shown to be shared, and #3319 is released (see its comment). This PR only refers to it.
- Engagement along the whole level is not measured. The pin checks where each level starts and ends.
- Outside on a closed pocket (no Outside containment) starts at the pocket wall. That ring is a full slot, as expected for that choice. Auto stays the default.
- 2D Offset with "Do not touch" picks (`pocket_avoid_started`) is wired, but no test runs Outside with avoid picks.
- No GUI screenshot was taken.

Process change: yes (one row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`)

Changelog: 2D Offset: new "Pass starts at" option (Auto / Inside / Outside) on the Passes tab. Outside starts each level at the outer edge, so an Outside containment no longer slots the stock. Auto keeps the earlier order.

Effort: high

Fixes #3316
